story_type: two men cut off by the tide on a rock island overnight, swimmer lowered, basket hoists over breaking surf, hoist camera
hook: They walked out at low tide. Then the sea cut them off.
narration: These two walked out to a rock island at low tide, and then the ocean cut them off.
They were believed to have been stuck out there all night, off Trinidad, California.
A good Samaritan spotted them and called the Coast Guard in Humboldt Bay.
A helicopter crew lowered a rescue swimmer right onto the island.
The basket goes down empty, the swimmer loads one person, and the flight mechanic reels it up through the rotor wash.
The first man came up over the rocks.
Then the basket went back down for the second.
He came up the same way, with waves breaking white on the rocks below.
outcome: The Humboldt Bay crew hoisted both men off the island, then brought their swimmer up last.
title: Cut off by the tide on a rock island
description:
A Coast Guard Sector Humboldt Bay helicopter crew hoisted two people who were stranded on Pewetole Island off Trinidad, California, on Feb. 11, 2018. They had walked to the island at low tide and were believed to have been there overnight.
